about: The scene each lesson of Hevalo’s book opens with, composed by hand (read by api/src/books/pictures.ts). shot: wide (everyone whole), mid (head to waist) or close (head and shoulders). set: day, dusk, night or snow; room: the scene is indoors, its window across the panel from 0 to 1 (null: no window). cast: who, their pose, their middle across the panel from 0 to 1, back (set back), flip, down (points lower). things: show (a book spot, a word picture, sapling, or landmark:<id>), at (ground, back, front, hand, mouth, head, on, wall, sill, sky), x (across the panel; on a thing, -1 to 1 across its top), y (sky and wall), of (whose hands), on (the index of the thing it stands on), size (times its own size).
